blocks.text: The AI Guard dashboard provides a high-level overview of all the AI applications AI Guard manages, but if you want to view additional details on specific transactions, you need to view the detection summary found in the transaction details window.

To access a transaction detection summary, go to AI Security Admin Portal > AI Guard > Dashboard. In the dashboard, find the transaction you want to view, go to the Details column, and click View Details. The Transaction Details window opens.
On the Transaction Details window, you can view the following information:

blocks.item: View or copy the Transaction ID.
The Overview section contains the following information:
Date: Date and time of the transaction.
App: The app that the prompt was submitted through.
Severity: Strength of the prompt's triggering of the policy detector: Info > Low > Medium > High > Critical.
Policy: Name of the policy that was triggered.
LLM: Name of the LLM used for analyzing the prompt or sending the response.
LLM Model: Specific LLM model used for this transaction (such as: claude-sonnet-4-6).
User Agent: Information about the user's agent where the prompt was written or the response was sent to.
The Detection Summary section contains the following information:
Prompt Detections: Shows which detectors were triggered by the prompt.
Details: Clicking for more details will show additional information about the detectors that were triggered.
Prompt Action: Shows whether the prompt was blocked, allowed, or just detected.
Prompt Tags: Shows an tags associated with the prompt.
Response Detections: Shows which detectors were triggered by the response.
Details: Clicking for more details will show additional information about the detectors that were triggered.
Response Action:Shows whether the response was blocked, allowed, or just detected.
Response Tags: Shows an tags associated with the response.
The Performance & Network Stats section contains the following information:
Prompt Size: File size of the prompt.
Response Size: File size of the response.
Total Time Taken by LLM: Length of time the LLM took to process the prompt and send a response
LLM Provider Status Code: An HTTP status code that corresponds to the status of the request. For example, 200 means Acceptable Response.
Detection Time On Request: Time it took to analyze the prompt.
Detection Time On Response: Time it took to analyze the response.
Region: Region of the app's server.
Protocol: Protocol used by the transaction.
Custom Request Headers: This section will show any custom headers that were set up in the AI Guard tenant settings page.
Prompt and Response Details: In this section you can read the specific prompt sent by the user and the response sent by the GenAI app.
Add to Allowlist: If you have the proper permissions, when you reveal a prompt or response that was blocked, you can click this option to add the prompt or response to your allowlist.
